# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional source edits were required in this apply-fixes pass. The approved carbonate-equilibrium rollout was already present in the worktree, including the explicit solver-driven pH path, save-load carbonate cache normalization, preset validation, and the daily shrimp-path carbonate refresh, so this stage verified the integrated state rather than patching code again.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Review the prior apply-fixes and validation outputs, then inspect the current worktree for unresolved carbonate follow-up items.
1. [Skipped] Apply any remaining carbonate-solver follow-up fixes; skipped because the review approved the implementation with no actionable amendments.
2. [Completed] Re-run regression and quality checks to confirm the approved carbonate/state-contract implementation remains green in the current workspace.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short` showed no tracked source deltas; only the unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory is present.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed, including chemistry, save/load, shrimp-feeding-pathway, shrimp-population, substrate/filter integration, and end-to-end coverage.
- `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed (4 tests), including shipped source-water carbonate differentiation and out-of-range carbonate pH rejection.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` still uses an aquarium-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so any future extension beyond the intended freshwater pH 5.5-8.5 envelope should revisit the chemistry model.
- The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.
